```{css, echo=FALSE}
.image-icon .bi-code-slash {
  color: #363632;
  position:absolute;
  background: #FEFEFA99;
  left: 92%;
  top: 5%;
  padding: 5px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  border: 1px solid #686864;
}

.bi-code-slash {
  float: right;
  padding: 5px;
}
```

<!-- Examples for inspiration: -->
<!-- https://avrodrigues.github.io/dataviz.html -->
<!-- https://www.etiennebacher.com/gallery -->

```{r,echo=FALSE}

library(glue)
figure_quarto <- function(
    img_tag, ## like: '![](image.png)'
    code_src = NULL ## an url
){
  img_tag <- glue::glue(
    "<img src={img_tag} width='100%' border='1px solid #555' style='border-radius: 5px;'>"
  )
  
  if(!is.null(code_src)){
    icon_tag <- glue::glue(
      "<a href={code_src} target='_blank'><i class='bi bi-code-slash'></i></a>"
    )
    
    figure_tag <- glue(
      "
      :::{{.figure}}

      {icon_tag}
      {img_tag}

      :::

      ")
  } else {
    figure_tag <- glue(
      "
      :::{{.figure}}

      {img_tag}

      :::

      ")
  }

  cat(figure_tag)

}
```

```{r}
# source("R/figure_quarto.R")

# Map of the Owyhee River watershed (The Wild Owyhee)
figure_quarto("/showcase/owyhee/precip.png",
              'https://github.com/bmbrost/bmbrost.github.io/blob/main/showcase/owyhee/owyhee.R')

# Population density of the Colorado Plateau and Southern Rockies
figure_quarto("/showcase/bertin/bertin.png",
              # '![](/showcase/dgo/dgo.png)',
              'https://github.com/bmbrost/bmbrost.github.io/blob/main/showcase/bertin/bertin.R')

# Unknown Treasures
figure_quarto("/showcase/treasures/treasures.png",
              # '![](/showcase/dgo/dgo.png)',
              'https://github.com/bmbrost/bmbrost.github.io/blob/main/showcase/treasures/treasures.R')

```
